assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The appeal concerns CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope (R55)
The clinical indication note documents transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The clinical indication note documents known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies
The claim is denied based on authorization/precertification reason code CO-197
The outstanding balance to be paid is 555.69
